title: Electric Terrain

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Explosion, Hurricane, Hydro Vortex, Muddy Water, Self-Destruct, Smack Down, Surf, and Thousand Arrows also count as Electric for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Explosion, Hurricane, Hydro Vortex, Muddy Water, Self-Destruct, Smack Down, Surf, Thousand Arrows, and Wildbolt Storm: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Electric-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Tectonic Rage breaks the field apart, exposing whatever lay beneath it.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Electromorphosis or Lightning Rod: Special Attack +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Volt Absorb restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Speed +1 and is charged.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
